text:
mina: saw a brief spike in retries + TLS errors at 04:12 UTC across ap-south and eu-west. looks related to a route flip during cert rotation. opening follow-up to track owners/timeline.

ravi: confirmed. traces show clients with cached DNS kept sending to old IPs and some got routed to fallback pool where cert rotation finished slightly later -> intermittent SNI rejects.

cleo: i reproduced in staging by forcing TTL=420s and flipping routes. mismatch window ~50s produced ~2% handshake failures for aggressive SDKs.

mina: quick actions suggested: 1) cert rotation sanity check (owner: cleo, ETA: 48h) 2) LB fallback handshake probe before promoting (owner: ravi, ETA: 72h) 3) reduce edge DNS TTL during active rollouts 420->90s (owner: mina, ETA: 24h) 4) add small alert for cross-region retry >1.3x baseline (owner: mina, ETA: 36h).

cleo: i'll add cert-compare in rotation job: fetch /_internal/cert from pools and ensure serial + notBefore match, else pause. PR incoming.

ravi: LB probe plan: do a TLS client hello + validate SNI/cert chain; only mark fallback healthy once probe passes. i'll add canary and rollback steps.

mina: TTL change will need registrar update. i'll coordinate with netops and schedule a 30m window tomorrow 09:15 UTC.

ops-bot: Automated: maintenance window created for DNS TTL change on 2026-09-22T09:15Z (owner: mina).

cleo: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1189 (cert preflight). staging tests running.

ravi: LB gating branch pushed, staging canary scheduled. rollback command `infra rollback lb-gate --to previous` added to playbook.

mina: created tracker ISSUE-5588 and added tasks + owners: https://redwood-internal/triage/ISSUE-5588. please post start/done updates in this thread.

cleo: started work on rotation job change.

ravi: started LB probe implementation; will report canary results.

mina: we'll monitor retry and tls metrics for 48h after changes. thanks all.
